name: What are the common types of kitchen cabinet materials?

mainEntity.name: What are the common types of kitchen cabinet materials?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common kitchen cabinet materials include solid wood (like maple, cherry, oak), plywood, MDF (medium-density fiberboard), and particleboard. Solid wood offers durability and a classic look, often at a higher cost. Plywood is a strong, stable, and moisture-resistant option. MDF is an engineered wood product known for its smooth finish and affordability, ideal for painted cabinets. Particleboard is the most budget-friendly but less durable. Each material has distinct characteristics regarding appearance, durability, and price point.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common cabinet materials are solid wood, plywood, MDF, and particleboard, each offering different aesthetics, durability, and price points.
